additional_info.subject: RE: 0373540 - ID0373540-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / N9 160381801] Charging point is out of service CRM:02023000079
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Over the period of 4 Weeks,
We could be able to see following:
for reported issue of outlet DC1, we could see that most of them are due to temperature Sensor Error.
PLC-Error-Flag 'Outlet_DC1_codes' changed to true - (DC1 Outlet not ready - charging cable temperature sensor err)
2024-07-25T16:09:02.906061+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/7ece98de7334[699]: PLC-Error-Flag 'DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100' changed to true - (VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1)
VIV:0 - in case of an invalid sensor reading
PLE:1 - in case of a plausibility error (temperature difference between +/- too high)
KON:1 - Contact Temp sensor is fine
Suspected root cause can be
- Water ingress on CCS Plug leading to wrong CP readings (HW Problem)
- Corrosion of connector blades
We can have a visual inspection. We can measure CP pin to ground. If Voltage is different from constant 12V DC, the cable must be replaced. Report the findings on the ticket.
we recommend you carry one spare ECOG at site.
After all the above investigation, we may have to consider replacing the Cable.
